title: Corrupt beads flatfiles: cdwm + l1qw.10.5.5 skipped as unmarshalable
description: bd emits 'warning: skipping corrupt issue ... unmarshal issue ... invalid character < looking for beginning of object key string' for .beads/issues/project-LICHEN-worker6-cdwm.json and project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.5.5.json on every bd command in the worker7 checkout. The files contain HTML (likely an error page) instead of JSON, so those issues are invisible to bd ready/list until repaired or regenerated. Files need human inspection before deletion (workspace no-delete default).
